G03 LiDAR degradation: heavy noise and invalid returns
G04 camera dropout: the image stream stops (perception gating opens downstream first)
G05 stale/repeated sensor data: odometry repeats its last measurement
G06 sensor rate reduction: IMU publishes at a quarter of its rate
G07 perception processing delay: 0.4 s of real work per scan
G08 perception degradation: empty obstacle sets
G09 localization failure: pose jump and uncertainty spike
G10 planning failure: the planner emits no path
G11 control failure: erratic velocity commands
G12 communication delay: perception output delayed 0.4 s
G13 communication loss: 60 % of LiDAR messages dropped in flight
G14 node crash: perception process dies abruptly and is respawned
G15 process restart: localization stops cleanly and is respawned after 4 s

common_evidence_subset.inclusion_criterion: scenario declares a ground-truth root cause; defined before the comparison and independent of which method succeeded
